system.description: With this rite a theurge can drive out any dark power which is influencing or possessing the target (usually psychic or Antinomic domination and demonic possession, although the influence of Ur-artifacts and certain aliens can also be dispelled in this way). Exorcism can be a long and arduous process. It is a sustained action, and the exorcist needs to accumulate 25 victory points in order to rid the target of whatever is possessing or influencing him.
